name: Effect: restring (octave down)
notes: An effect for in front of any amp: no amp and no cab here, and auto_level off, so the virtual string comes out at about your guitar's level. Each pick plucks a virtual string an octave down with your own DI's last period. Physics: the string (its length, stiffness, losses; vibrato and bends as tension changes). Not physics: the pitch tracker (15-30 ms after the pick, one note). Mix 1 = only the virtual string; lower adds your own guitar.
